title: Minimum radius calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 150 m.

title: Centripetal force condition
description: Important: The student must apply the condition that the required centripetal force is provided by the maximum static friction.

title: Inclination angle tangent
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 1/4 (or 0.25).

title: Banked curve force balance
description: Important: For part (2), the student must resolve forces correctly to show the centripetal force comes from the horizontal component of the normal force.

title: Correct use of given data
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the given values: v=30 m/s, friction coefficient k=0.6, g (9.8 or 10 m/s²), and radius r=360 m for part (2).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All physical quantities should be expressed in consistent SI units throughout the derivation.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns the direction of the frictional force or normal force components.

title: Confusing static friction condition
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses kinetic friction or misapplies the inequality f ≤ μN for part (1).
